commands.name: wallpaper_list
commands.description: Lists every wallpaper in System Settings > Wallpaper, whether it's on this Mac, and which is current.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": System Settings has no scripting for this.

example_requests: What wallpapers can I choose?
Which desktop pictures are built in?
What's my current wallpaper?
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared or the result wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: a System Settings dialog is already open, or another app came to the front; nothing more was done

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background"

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with System Settings 15.0 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.
Takes about 20 s: the list is scrolled through and each group opened with Show All.

commands.name: wallpaper_set
commands.description: Sets the desktop picture of every display and Space to a named wallpaper from System Settings > Wallpaper.

args.name: name
args.meaning: The wallpaper's name as the pane shows it, e.g. Sonoma or Plum.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": System Settings has no scripting for this.

example_requests: Set my wallpaper to Sonoma
Change the desktop background to a plain blue color
Use the iMac Blue wallpaper
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.
commands.postcondition: The pane and macOS's wallpaper store show the wallpaper.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared or the result wasn't seen in time

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background"

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no wallpaper has that name

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: the wallpaper isn't on this Mac (it would be downloaded), Show on all Spaces is off, a System Settings dialog is open, or another app came to the front; nothing was done

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with System Settings 15.0 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.

Wallpaper buttons ignore the Accessibility press, so the wallpaper is clicked in the middle of its own named button's frame, only once that frame is wholly inside the visible list and window (scrolled there with the wheel over the list's own frame, its group opened with Show All); never fixed screen positions.
Wallpapers not on this Mac (that System Settings would download from Apple, such as Ventura and most aerials on the tested Mac) are refused, not downloaded.

commands.name: login_item_remove
commands.description: Stops an item opening at login: its Open at Login row is selected and checked by name, then Remove (the app isn't touched).

args.name: name
args.meaning: The item's name as Open at Login shows it.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": System Settings has no scripting for this.

example_requests: Stop Calculator opening at login
Remove Stickies from my login items
Don't start this app when I log in
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.
commands.postcondition: The item is gone from Open at Login; the app is unchanged.
